label: Screen, media and creative technology (createch)
definition: Screen, media and creative technology, including immersive experience, creative AI and advanced digital media.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors

label: Frontier innovation
definition: Deep tech, life sciences, medtech, cleantech, security and related research.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors

label: Advanced manufacturing
definition: Robotics, materials, scientific instrumentation, aerospace-linked activity and advanced food technology.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors

label: Clean energy
definition: Low-carbon freight, hydrogen, carbon reduction in manufacturing, heat networks and low-carbon development.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors

label: Digital
definition: Data centres, IT hardware and software.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors

label: Heathrow-linked industries
definition: Aviation, air freight, logistics and supply chains linked to Heathrow.
source: WLA, Opportunity West London 2026/27, priority growth sectors
